paper_title: Constraints on dark photons and axion-like particles from SuperCDMS Soudan
notes: Paper sets two limits: axioelectric coupling g_ae (AxionElectron) and dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon (DarkPhoton). Reported AxionElectron here per hint. Abstract states g_ae below 1e-12 reached for masses of a few-hundred eV/c2, and mass range 40 eV to 500 keV. No numerical table available; data_points are rough estimates read from the described results (Fig. 12), so extraction_confidence is low. Local DM density 0.3 GeV/cm3 assumed. 90% CL. A corrected limit (Figs 12/13) accounts for ~32% signal loss in iZIP. Values are approximate/uncertain. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.4, 6))
